speaker: judith_sadler
text: They are in a row already. I can hear the corner from here, and there is no corner left at the board to win.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Let them have the argument. It walks itself home.

speaker: judith_sadler
text: Take this, then. One corner, in a cloth, for the one who does not spend the lane on it. If it arrives, it arrives.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Susanna will have it. She is the one of the three who can carry a cloth and a quarrel without joining the quarrel.

speaker: hamnet_sadler
text: Will. Seven. I will not come down the lane to fetch you, and I will not say twelve again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You will not have to fetch me. Go back to the oven. It is more patient than a promise.

speaker: judith_sadler
text: That is modest enough to end on. Go, before he thinks of a better sentence.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: We are going. The three are ahead. We shall look as if we meant them to be.
